title: Dashboards (zh-CN): drill chips show raw ISO dates (「≥ 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z」), and 「Region」 / 「New bar chart」 stay English
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Found by the milestone acceptance of #36255 (record #37022) on main `305fe60e`, zh-CN session. One sighting each.

- **Date chip:** the drill dialog's date chip reads 「创建时间：≥ 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z」, while the same dialog's title shows 2026-10.
- **Region label:**
  - the drill chip reads 「Region：EMEA」, and the edit-mode filter bar reads 「Region: 全部」;
  - view mode reads 区域.
- **New card title:** the add-card default title is the English 「New bar chart」.

**Expected:** dates formatted by the dashboard's granularity and locale, and labels from the translated field or filter label, not the API name or an English default.

QA-source: #37022 · dashboards.global-filters-rescope · observed beside the clauses
